{
  "project_id": "P-IND-ChhattisgarhAcceleratedLearning",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Extreme heatwaves, erratic monsoons, droughts, and floods disrupt the annual academic calendar, forcing school closures and reducing instructional days.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Climate-proof school infrastructure, digitize learning resources/records, and implement flexible remedial plans to compensate for lost instructional days.",
      "evidence": "vulnerable to droughts and floods due to erratic monsoons and heat waves that can force extensions of the annual school summer break"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "High dropout rates among secondary and senior secondary adolescent boys due to family economic pressure and available informal labor market jobs.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Expand access to quality senior secondary science and commerce education, introduce residential facilities for boys, and engage SMCs on student retention.",
      "evidence": "GER for adolescent boys is visible in the secondary (83.2 percent) and senior secondary grades (52.3 percent) as compared with girl students"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Acute shortage of subject-specialized teachers leads to non-subject teachers managing key subjects like Mathematics and Science, reducing instructional quality.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and deploy grade- and subject-wise structured lesson plans and establish need-based in-service teacher professional development programs.",
      "evidence": "a lack of subject teachers in schools managed by the GoCG has resulted in Language teachers teaching Mathematics, English, and Sciences."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Insufficient technical capacity and staffing within the SCERT Assessment Cell (SAC) to design, administer, and analyze periodic diagnostic and state-level achievement assessments.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Engage external technical support agencies through the IPF component to build SAC capacity and competitively hire dedicated assessment staff.",
      "evidence": "The lack of a standardized system to assess student learning through a diagnostic lens restricts the nodal educational institutions’ ability to identify issue(s)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Fiscal space constraints in state budget limit new teacher recruitment despite an increasing market availability of subject-specialist teachers.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Transition to large composite schools (Grades K-12) to achieve economies of scale and optimize existing teacher deployment across grades.",
      "evidence": "efforts get limited by the available fiscal space to hire new teachers despite the increasing availability of subject teachers in the market."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Delays in budget releases and low budget execution rates caused by multi-tiered planning processes and limited financial management capacity across executing entities.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide technical assistance for financial management, streamline annual work plan preparation, and establish a dedicated PMC to support budget execution.",
      "evidence": "multiple tiers of planning and implementation and their limited capacities to prepare and manage budgets often result in inadequately planned budgeting and consequent delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Financial management internal control weaknesses, including un-cleared advances, long-standing capital work in progress, and unresolved statutory audit queries dating back to 2009.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish an Audit Committee to resolve historical statutory audit findings, conduct risk-based internal audits, and set up district-level compliance camps.",
      "evidence": "there exist unresolved/ addressed statutory observations since FY 2009-10."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Inexperience of SIS-SS staff with World Bank Procurement Regulations for consultancy services under the IPF component, threatening contract award timelines.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize the World Bank STEP platform, deploy experienced procurement specialists within the PMC, and conduct extensive procurement capacity-building workshops.",
      "evidence": "Procurement risks related to the IPF component include the inexperience of the SIS-SS to process consultancy services following World Bank Procurement Regulations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Civil works for school construction and refurbishment create occupational health and safety hazards, traffic risks, construction waste, and disruption to ongoing classes.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Standardize Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) clauses in bidding documents, enforce environmental screening, and require School Improvement Plans prior to civil works.",
      "evidence": "Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) and Community Health and Safety (CHS) issues include fire and electric safety, possible traffic incidents"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Locating upgraded model composite schools in coal mining areas exposes students and facilities to elevated air/noise pollution and environmental degradation.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate environmental greening and tree plantation protocols, install energy-efficient/ventilation-focused designs, and coordinate with the Forest/Horticulture departments.",
      "evidence": "Environmental risks and impacts associated with the location of school premises, air/noise pollution in mining areas, dust and disposal of construction waste"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Potential regulatory changes in Personal Data protection laws impacting the collection, storage, and processing of student and teacher personal data within EMIS.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct technical impact assessments of new privacy legislation, adhere to national and international data protection standards, and eliminate personal data from public reports.",
      "evidence": "the approval of any new legislation regarding Personal Data protection may have an impact on the activities financed by the Operation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Operational bottlenecks and lack of seamless information interfaces between PFMS and banking systems under the Single Nodal Account (SNA) model leading to transaction delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Standardize accounting software (Tally) across sub-implementing agencies (PWD/RES), deliver bank/agency user training, and establish zero-balance child accounts under CHALK-SNA.",
      "evidence": "lack of effective information interface between the PFMS system and the Banking network... increased reliance on the banking network has become a bottleneck"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Lack of a dedicated, online procurement complaint redressal mechanism leading to delayed handling of contractor grievances and potential procurement disputes.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a comprehensive online procurement complaint handling portal with clear protocols, mandatory public award disclosures, and defined escalation levels.",
      "evidence": "Currently, there is no dedicated mechanism in place to treat procurement-related complaints promptly."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Long-term energy transition and coal mine closures over 20-30 years threaten local livelihoods in mining districts unless youth are equipped with alternative skills.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize at least 5% of model composite schools in coal mining blocks offering quality senior secondary science and commerce education to support just transition.",
      "evidence": "India's long-term goal of reaching net zero by 2070... will result in the gradual closure of coal mines that produce 85 percent"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Generation of unmanaged e-waste and solid waste from the procurement and lifecycle end-of-life of digital IT hardware for EMIS and assessment systems.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Include mandatory e-waste disposal requirements in vendor TORs conforming to E-Waste Management Rules 2016 and implement segregated waste collection.",
      "evidence": "development of the state's EMIS, if at all, may generate some e-waste and solid waste (including plastics, and paper) in the nodal institutions."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Operational inefficiencies and multigrade teaching in fragmented, small primary schools due to low per-grade enrolment and high per-pupil expenditure.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop high-enrolment model composite hub schools while financing minor repairs in surrounding spoke primary schools to preserve access and operational efficiency.",
      "evidence": "fragmented school functioning have led to multi-grade teaching and higher per-pupil expenditure."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Extreme heatwaves, erratic monsoons, droughts, and floods disrupt the annual academic calendar, forcing school closures and reducing instructional days.
risks.mitigation: Climate-proof school infrastructure, digitize learning resources/records, and implement flexible remedial plans to compensate for lost instructional days.
